description: This file defines a RuntimeLocator for identifying and verifying the Node runtime version, including classes and methods for version parsing, comparison, and error handling.

classes.name: RuntimeVersion
classes.description: Represents a semantic version with major, minor, and patch components, supporting comparison and string conversion.

classes.name: RuntimeResolution
classes.description: Holds information about the located runtime's kind, path, and version.

methods.name: from(string:)
methods.description: Parses a version string into a RuntimeVersion object.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Attempts to locate and verify the Node runtime, returning success or detailed failure.

methods.name: describeFailure
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of a RuntimeResolutionError.
